summary: Slots: optional `header`, optional `media` (Default only), and `children` for the content stack. (Package docs; Coin has no designer guide for Card.)

examples.purpose: A slim card holding a line of content.
examples.jsx:
<Card variant="slim" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <Text text="September payment" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
</Card>

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual layout variant matching Figma `Property 1`. - `'default'` — header + optional media + content (Figma Default) - `'slim'` — header + content only; `media` is ignored (Figma Slim) Defaults to `'default'`. Existing call sites that omit `media` continue to render a media-less default card (backward compatible). Prefer `variant="slim"` when you want the Slim contract explicitly. Default "default", from the component source.

props.name: header
props.description: Content rendered in the header slot at the top of the card (e.g. a brand logo). Sits above the media slot, padded with `card/content/padding/*`.

props.name: media
props.description: Media slot content (e.g. `<Image />`). Wrapped in a container that respects `mediaAspectRatio`. Ignored when `variant="slim"`.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes object for token resolution. Cascades into all slots.

props.name: mediaAspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio for the media slot container. Defaults to the Figma Ratio 154/116 (~1.328). Default 1.3276 (154 / 116), from the component source.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the card container.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (`Pressable` + `accessibilityRole="button"`).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label forwarded to the root.

props.name: Card.Title
props.description: A static sub-component of Card. Its own props: children, style, modes, numberOfLines.

props.name: Card.SupportText
props.description: A static sub-component of Card. Its own props: children, style, modes, numberOfLines.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: A token collection Card reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
